summary: Hutchinson's two recorded actions as an Oakland USD board member worked against Palestinian justice. In November 2023, as board president, he refused to let hundreds of Gaza ceasefire protesters speak and abruptly ended the meeting. In February 2024, he backed blocking a Gaza ceasefire resolution from the agenda despite four of seven members supporting it. His campaign platform addresses only district education policy.
